bio: Tony Mencio, from Cedar Park, Texas, performed as a soprano with the Santa Clara Vanguard (2008-2011) and earned a music degree from the University of North Texas. His drum corps teaching began in 2012 with the Blue Knights, followed by the Crossmen (2013-2015) and seven years with The Guardians, the last four as Visual Caption Head. He now serves as Visual Caption Manager for the Crossmen and is Director of Band and Orchestra at Arlington Grand Prairie High School.

Travis Barzee marched three seasons with the Cavaliers (2010-12) and aged out with the Blue Devils (2013). He went on to teach visually at The Academy (2015) and the Santa Clara Vanguard (2016-2021), and has worked with Phantom Regiment as an active drill writer, visual consultant, and choreographer. He is Director of Bands at Grain Valley High School in Missouri and graduated from the University of Central Missouri with a degree in Music Education.

Trent Gronewold is a Southern California-based percussion arranger, sound designer, and educator. He marched front ensemble with the Blue Stars (2015-2016), Santa Clara Vanguard (2018), and Pulse Percussion. He has served as Front Ensemble Arranger for Gold Drum and Bugle Corps (2021-2022), Pacific Crest (2023-2024), and the Mandarins, and his accolades include a WGI Championship, a DCI Championship, and a Fred Sanford High Percussion Award.

Tyler Propfe is an elementary music educator based in West Chester, Pennsylvania who works as a designer, choreographer, and drill writer across the mid-Atlantic. He marched with the Connecticut Hurricanes (2006-2015) and the Bluecoats (2013-2014), then taught as visual co-caption head with Jersey Surf (2016-2017) and on the visual staff of The Academy (2019-2023). He joined the Blue Stars in 2023 as Assistant Visual Caption Head and holds degrees from West Chester University and Lindenwood University.

Aaron Stickley, originally from Kingsport, Tennessee, performed with the 2012 Madison Scouts and 2014 Carolina Crown on lead baritone and trumpet. Before joining the Santa Clara Vanguard brass staff in 2022 as baritone instructor, he taught brass for both Genesis and the Madison Scouts. A graduate of Middle Tennessee State University, he is Assistant Director of Bands at The Woodlands High School in Texas and works as a visual designer and choreographer.
